author: Jerseys
body:
• My username is Dynamohh, but will be recently changed to Rowth
  • I have banned for hacking on my alt called SmoshWars
  • I should be unbanned because I haven't alted for over 20 days. I have not even alted once from that day. I have changed my attitude and wont commit a crime again. Everyone deserves a second chance, even the hated ones.  I hacked because I thought my Minecraft days were over but i shouldn't hack on the server I love. I'v learnt my lesson, and I will never ever do it again. I'm sorry...

replies.body:
Hello,
You were caught ban evading and this is something very difficult to appeal. I don't want to appeal you until you actually learned a lesson, and served your punishment. 23 days isn't enough.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
